text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head to the track on my day off and
spot
Symboli Kris S and Fine Motion
engaging in extra
training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going to wrap up soon.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, already? That's a bit unusual.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I was scheduled to rest today... I'm going
to
stop... before I exhaust myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, while perusing some race-related
materials
at the library...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me. That book you have...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
May I take a look at it... when you're
finished? I
need it for... research.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...It's my duty.
choice_data_list: いいけど、休みの日もレース研究か？
いいけど、休みの日もレース研究？
choice_data_list_en: Sure, but studying races on your day off, too?
Sure, but studying races even on your day off?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Kris S makes it a habit to get up to date
with the
most recent materials on her
days off. ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Information and common
knowledge—both are
in constant flux.
Research... is important.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You're always prioritizing your
duties, even
on your rest days.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
But you must have realized by now...
that
accompanying me on such days... is
not enjoyable
for you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure I agree with that. I end up
learning an
awful lot, and just spending
time with you is a lot
of fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even on her day off, Symboli Kris S is as

disciplined as ever. She continues
analyzing her
own data and looking over
footage of strong
racers for a while, but
then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All of a sudden, she comes to a
complete
standstill, as if she's ceased to
function
altogether.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Today's routine has reached its end. I
will now
rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...There is no need to perform any
actions that do
not contribute... to the
completion of my mission.
choice_data_list_en: ...And that brought things to a halt?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? Are you positive there's
nothing else
you ought to do?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I mean, we're both exchange students.
We've only
a limited amount of time in
Japan to learn what
we can.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think there's more to all this
than just
learning about racing? I reckon
familiarizing
yourself with Japanese
culture is an important
duty as well!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I follow your logic. But...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...How am I to fulfill that duty?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There's only one thing to have, then!
The ultimate
cuisine for the
masses—ramen! Luckily for us,
they're
serving a limited-edition lightly salted

ramen in the cafeteria as we speak. ♪
choice_data_list: 日本の食文化に触れよう

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the first thing you must do is
to have a
nice sip of the broth. Go
ahead and scoop up a
big spoonful. ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I am unaccustomed to rich flavors, but I
shall try...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Astounding... They used such pure water
for this...
Perhaps it's soft water... or
spring water?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, you can tell?! Apparently,
they use
specially sourced water to
make both the noodles
and the broth!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...That stands to reason.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: This tastes... really good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S spends her day off a little

differently from usual and happily enjoys
a small
but significant taste of Japanese
culture.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I don't have time. I must be back at the
dorm...
before the curfew.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If it's time constraints you're worried
about, I
have just the solution! I'll
charter us a helicopter
right away!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We barely have time to process what
Fine Motion
said before we find
ourselves seated in a
helicopter and on
an impromptu scenic tour.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
That was... utterly absurd. Albeit... we
did make it
in time for curfew.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But isn't it nice that we were able to see
so many
incredible sights? The sea, the
mountains, even
some hot springs! Hehe,
that was great fun. ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Today... was a nice day off. ...Thank you.
